notes.title: Get ready to descend into the abyss...
notes.content:
[h2]Subterrain: Mines of Titan is available NOW![/h2]

We do realize here, that many of you expressing that this isn't Subterrain 2 and are not interested with the game. We get that. For those, we still want to thank you for still supporting Subterrain and we REALLY do hope that one day, we can come back to the original Subterrain 2. When that will be? we can't say today. But one thing is for sure, and that is we have made through another game and still here! Following the original path of Subterrain is one of my life goal and God willing, I may see it happening one day.

But today is different day. Today, we humbly release our next game. Subterrain: Mines of Titan.

For anyone who is interested, please treat this game as completely different game that shares Subterrain universe.

Again we offer a massive thank you to everyone who's been part of this incredible journey through the years of development. The mystery of Titan beckons, and we can't wait for you to uncover its secrets.

[hr][/hr]
[previewyoutube=st7tUfeurRA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]🔍 Uncover the Secrets of Titan[/h3]
Embark on a quest for survival as you confront the lurking horrors below. Will you craft equipment, research new gear, fight against overwhelming odds, or uncover your true fate? Titan, an unrelenting world, demands your resilience, and every step you take advances time. Only you can intervene to prevent the collapse of Camp Huygens.

[h3]🌑 Survival Management[/h3]
Survive the unforgiving environment of Titan by managing resources, tracking time, and exploring abandoned mining tunnels. The fate of Camp Huygens rests on your shoulders.

[h3]⚔️ Turn-Based Combat[/h3]
Confront monstrous foes with brisk, intuitive turn-based combat. Choose your approach—close and personal or strategic plinking from afar. Harness the power of nanomachines, evolve alongside creatures, and adapt tactics to conquer Titan's mines.

[h3]🔧 Crafting System[/h3]
Craft an arsenal of items, salvage materials, and produce tools, weapons, protective gear, explosives, and survival upgrades. Enhance yourself with medical supplies and continue research to unearth the terrible truth.


[hr][/hr]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1573100/Subterrain_Mines_of_Titan/

[h3]💰 Celebrate & Save During Launch[/h3]
To celebrate the game's launch, Subterrain: Mines of Titan will be [b]10% off until March 28th![/b] Now is the perfect time to begin your adventure on Titan and determine Camp Huygens fate.

[h3]💞 How You Can Support Us[/h3]
As a small indie team, there are so many ways you can help support us and the game.
[list][*] If you buy the game, please consider leaving an honest review on Steam! Reviews have a massive impact on indie games and we'd love to see your thoughts and experiences through a review.
[*] Sharing the game through word of mouth with family and friends or on social media with your followers can really help spread the word and give others a chance to discover their next adventure. So many indies are discovered with a simple share or casual discussion.
[*] Join the amazing community in our [url=http://discord.gg/ERRSBJafXZ]Discord[/url] and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/pixellore]Twitter[/url] to share in the excitement and get to know other adventurous gamers exploring Titan.
[/list]

Thank you for your support!

The mystery of Titan beckons! 
[b]Pixellore🛠️🔦[/b]

notes.title: Subterrain : Mines of Titan
notes.content:
This is official announcement that the development of next game in Subterrain franchise is named:

Subterrain : Mines of Titan

Steam page has been updated with new character art direction too!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1573100/Subterrain__Mines_of_Titan/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1573100/Subterrain__Mines_of_Titan/[/url]

As some of you may already know, we have recently collected information about the naming of the game and the direction of the game that the player wants.

Here is a brief summery of the poll result.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40087544/db4a5b2fc0b113bc39dcd492727b23a1d92ba563.png[/img]

Around 70% responded as the game should be called something else.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40087544/b0f102c8ddbcf8c911699a05b31ff5aa85cbd4d9.png[/img]

Also, interestingly enough, around  80% said they would follow it if it was named as other title such as Mines of Titan.

The results were pretty strong and clear.

Having observed above and the game is moving on with Subterrain : Mines of Titan. A kind of spin off series like direction, we would like to give a brief detail on the direction of the game we have taken. We think the fans of the first game deserves a bit more explanation as of why we are creating Mines of Titan.

Please read on if you are interested.

When we first started to develop another game in Subterrain universe, the goal was simple, to create another good game within the same game universe, possibly with "2" on it and hence the base of the game play very similar to the first game. So the first few prototypes were top down shooter, isometric top down shooter, and we even tried 3D ! 

We felt good about them, however, after couple of months into the development, something unexpected happened. The main reason why we felt that we are going to be able to pull off another Subterrain game was that the original artist and designer of the game was able to rejoin the team. Unfortunately, after couple of months into the development, that member of the team had to leave again. The reason behind the resignation was purely personal and we do not really want to discuss it here. But whatever the reason that was, at the end of the day, people make the game. We struggled for a quiet a while after that, but one thing was clear. Never give up! However, it was also clear that it would be very difficult for us to keep going at the same direction as we have originally started.

After considering a lot of options, rather than giving up, we have decided to create something that "we could" at the time of the decision was made with the best possible outcome in mind. There was several factors which we considered. Development budget, time, our own ability to produce certain types of art. We even had to consider another unfortunate event of losing another member of the team. Many of you were asking about the reason behind the turn based, but it was a decision that was made based on the best option we could out of what we had. It was not the choice of something that we thought one type would be better than the other.

Looking back, if we have given up, there would possibly be nothing. Nothing as no more Pixellore at all.
At least, now we believe we have maybe not Subterrain 2 as we have clearly been told by a lot of you, but something that is still decent game that we can keep building on.

Before I end the long story, I would like to finally give what to become of Subterrain 2.

If we ever survive another journey of finishing Subterrain : Mines of Titan and still be able to create another game called Subterrain 2, it will be : 

1. Top down shooter.
2. 2D.
3. Almost the same game play experience of the first game but improved.
4. Possibly multiplayer. ( this is highly unlikely, depends on the budget )
5. Announcing the game very early and get the feedback even earlier.

So, thank you all for giving us your feedback.

We will now move on and do our best to finish the Mines of Titan so that we have another chance of creating "real" Subterrain 2 sequel. We understand that our current game may not be for some of you, but please do consider supporting the game in anyway you can.

Thank you!

notes.title: Subterrain 2 Announcement
notes.content:
It has been around 7 years since we have been set on the journey to create independent game, and our first love was Subterrain 1. Since then, we have tried our best to keep going and create game with passion, no matter what the game was.

Now, we are very excited to make an announcement that Subterrain 2 is in development and show you the first glimpse of the game.

Subterrain 2 is in a nutshell, a sci-fi RPG. It is different to Subterrain 1 yet shares many similar game play elements. The most difference is that the game is now semi top-down turn based instead of real-time top down shooter. It was the decision that we made with no light heart, but the main reason for it was the following:

1.	Expand the world of Subterrain universe through more enriched Story and NPC interaction.
2.	Character development progression. Deeper survival elements.
3.	More tactical combat. More variations of everything!
4.	Less grinding!

Now that for those of you who were expecting almost the same game as Subterrain 1 may be disappointed, but after trying the former ( yes! we did try ) we felt that the top down action shooter was really not suitable for the goals we have set. 

Another important goal for the Subterrain 2 is that although having random map and replaying the game many times over is a good value, we found that majority of the players only played through the game once and the game was unnecessary long. Especially grinding part and sudden boss introduction was something that we wanted to avoid. We thought that having a solid good experience of 20 or so game play hours is more important than providing 100 hours of lesser remembering experience.

So here we are. No matter what happens next, we will try our best to get through to the end. And with your support, we can get there so much better.

Please consider supporting us by following the game, wish list and we will make sure to keep the update flow on the development. Come join us at forum, discord and share your feedback. Just like Subterrain 1, the game is going to be shaped by you. We are here to serve!

notes.title: Pixellore merging with Pixellore Inc
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

We have some news about change in ownership of Subterrain franchise in Steam.

Pixellore is moving on to Pixellore Inc, a bit more corp like company. They are effectively the same company, but Pixellore Inc existed to publish the game for PS4 platform. This will happen at 1st of Dec 2020

Now Pixellore will be merged into Pixellore Inc so we can deal better with all this company running business overhead.

Nothing will change in terms of game's availability on Steam, or who will be running the show in the future.

As for the other news, we are planning to open official Discord channel for Subterrain by the end of this month (Nov 2020). Hopefully a lot of you can join us there to discuss and talk about the game and (coming Subterrain 2)

Subterrain 2 continues to be developed and we wish to come up with our first closed public test demo version by the end of this year. We will probably make more news about that soon and ask some hardcore fans to come aboard to test the game for the very first time.

Thank you for all your support.

notes.title: Happy New Year 2017 !
notes.content:
Happy New Year 2017 ! 

https://youtu.be/CEllO6T14Dk

The video shows some base technology that I am basing the next game with. It's rather a long video, so you don't have to watch everything.
The next game from Pixellore will be a side view platform either in 2D or 3D with complex AI simulation. The tech demonstrate early version of the game editor with some tile painting, object placement and AI path finding. This isn't a game but it is just a path finding algorithm test.

Every agent has stupid AI that only knows where a random heart is and it attempts to go there and knows nothing else. This is built to test the path finding algorithm which has background threading path finding in dynamically changing world.

It was challenging to make it work with the stairs. The stairs introduces a lot more complex node creation rules for the path finding. Seems to run cool with almost less than 1ms on main thread with around 1000 agents so I am loving the threading a lot at the moment!

Anyway, happy 2017 everyone, and I hope I can share more on the new game as it gets developed.

notes.title: Recent updates and patches
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

There has been number of updates and patches and some of you may be wondering what they are all about.

They include anyting from minor bug fixes to the improvements to the game.
But most of the "bugs" are created from the changes in the game in preparation for the other platform releases. This include things like loading the assets for the game, saving and loading the data, and optimizations.

And some of you may wonder, why make changes to the Steam version? "Leave the Steam version as it is and not create more bugs!"

This is true. However, I am also bringing in all the positive changes implemented to the game while I am working on the porting to the other platforms. Good example is the recent lighting system changes which boosts huge performance. Also smoother loading system, faster random map generation etc..

I am still dedicated to fix any bugs in the game and I hope you can understand the process and some of the new bugs creeping in.

Thanks for your understanding and I hope you all enjoying Subterrain.

[b] BETA [/b]

- Updated : Dragging items from inventory into tactical slots will now work regardless of the item category. This is new feature so it is subject to some bugs.

- Updated : Infection rate calculation has changed a bit. The locations has better min o2 and temperature and it has some effects on the infection rate. The old save games may have some wrong values in them. But all future new games should have this update.

notes.title: Update 0.8.8.2 Last min Steam Sale!
notes.content:
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/CSzk_VfUAAE9FKS.jpg:large[/img]

It has been a frenzy time.. adding requested features, fixing bugs. Thanks to everyone reporting bugs!

[h1]Don't forget your last min Steam sale! It is the last one this year![/h1]

[h1]Release Note : Version 0.8.8.2  02 Nov 2015[/h1]

- Fixed : Bug with black out triggering during tube travel causing the warning UI to stay and cause other bugs.

- Fixed : Multiple grenades being used when throwing a grenade.

- Fixed : Research bug with laser baton and advanced bandage.

- Fixed : Sometimes cursor disappears when West dies from invasion battle.

- Update : Minimap zoom function! press zoom key to toggle minimap zoom.

- Update : Map will close if you press move key. (like inventory)

- Update : Invasion force arrival time has been increased.

- Update : Power recharger max level has been increased for Central control.

- Update : Core takes much less damage than before from invasion force.

- Update : Changed the way fog is being rendered. Small performance improvement and better minimap revealing to minimize the chance of player not realizing the area has not been discovered. The new method uses only West's vision instead of combination of light and vision.

- Update : Localized strings can now have {KEY} string and it will be replaced by the keys that are mapped using the keyboard remapping. (But we can't do anything about the tutorial tip images yet.)

Localization update : 

UI_Text : 

map_toggle_zoom 

system_loading_tip_01 - 11 (I have tried to modify the existing tranlation with new key placeholder text)

[h1]Release Note : Version 0.8.8.0  01 Nov 2015[/h1]

- Fixed : Power usage upon overheated and dropping weapon didn't count.

- Update : New slider control for production UI. 3Dprinter, Biocombiner, Mine, Farm now has quuantity slider to more control on how may per queue batch you want to produce.

- Update : Rebalanced items to take account of finer control of item production.

Localization update : 

UI_Text : jobqueue_production_current_quantity, jobqueue_production_quantity

[h1]Release Note : Version 0.8.7.9  30 Oct 2015[/h1]

- Fixed : Grenades can be used during tube travel. Lol...

- Fixed : Grenades disappearing when it is used rapidly.

- Fixed : Tube time control UI can appear when exit to menu from tube travel scene.

- Fixed : Attempt to fix loading bug with last floor of each location. Please try and report if you still have issues.

- Update : Power pack can be used in the tactical slot using hot keys to swap them.

- Update : Placed grenades in the Central control in the storage room for easier access to them in the beginning of the game.

- Update : Item recycle yield has lable to avoid confusion between crafting requirements.

- Update : Item detail takes account of its count. So if you have 10 items that yields 10 resin, it will show 100 resin. This will hopefully make a bit easier to see if you would have enough materials during your scavenging.

Localization update : 

UI_Text : itemdetail_recycle_yield

notes.title: Steam Halloween Sale.
notes.content:
We are running a small discount for Halloween. Given the nature of our game, we thought we can't possibly skip this one.

This is going to be our last sale this year as there aren’t much time left till the full release around Jan next year.

So this sale is your last chance to get the game a bit cheaper than usual for this year.

Just for the update news, we are working on the improvements of UI for crafting, mining and farming.

During November, we want to put in all effects and sounds and create a new release trailer as well as implement Steam trading cards.

By the end of November, the game's features will be locked down and we will just be focusing on fixing the remaining bugs and do as much polishing as possible. We think stability is going to be really important for the full release, so there would not be any new features added after November.

As for the plan after the release is still not 100% clear, ... it all depends on number of factors including how well the game actually do. If we get enough budget to be able to justify more major updates such as map mod editors or multiplayer, it may happen. If not, well...

I would like to take this moment to give thanks to those of you who were giving us valuable feedback. We simply could not have got this far without your help.

And special thanks to those who are contributing to the localization. You rock!

Make sure you enlist your alias in the forum to be included in the game's credits (if you want!)

Thanks everyone and happy Halloween!

notes.title: Update 0.8.7.8
notes.content:
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/CSZu78XUsAA0Eru.jpg:large[/img]

[h1]Release Note : Version 0.8.7.8  29 Oct 2015[/h1]

- Fixed : If West dies with tutorial guide pop up, it does not close.

- Fixed : West being able to use Tube when there is no power at the current location.

- Fixed : Grenade bug introduced while refactorying weapons code for the plasma lanucher.

- Update : Updated keyboard remapping to take input from mouse. Better input check.

- Update : New tab activated in the 3D printer to allow a conversion between basic materials at the cost of other matierals.

- Update : Updated tactical slot so that it can contain power pack items and increase width to take long items.

Localization change notes :

UI_Text : craft_catalog3_tab3 , craft_catalog3_tab4 , setting_keyboard_attack , setting_keyboard_drag , setting_keyboard_weaponswapup , setting_keyboard_weaponswapdown , setting_keyboard_notice

[h1]Release Note : Version 0.8.7.7  28 Oct 2015[/h1]

- Fixed : Master traveler achievements now always send total visited stats instead of incremental ones.

- New : New 3 ranged weapons! These are special type and you can only get them if you go with some minor side quest. This quest activates from the Herbert research center. Thanks to Commander Shepard for this one! Unfortunately, this means the most of the existing players won't be able to craft these, because this update requires a new special room to be generated, and the key items as well. Just becareful not to blow yourself up!

- Update : More medical room tile for random map.

- Update : Stun effects for electric powered melee weapons are now activated.

- Update : Oxygen warning is now about how much you have in your suit tank, instead of how much oxygen is in West's body. This will hopefully warns the players early enough so they can take right actions.

- Update : Increased evolution timing (again..) to reflect recent feedback about the game being too difficult after say day 20 or so.

This update requires updating the localization file :

Items : 69,70,71,75,76,77

UI_Text has been changed as well to reflect the changed oxygen warning.

Oxygen tutorial image has been changed. Russian image need to change as well.

This version is going to be a beta only to test the weapons and changed systems.

Enroll to beta build if you would like to test them!

Thanks!

notes.title: Switching default game to new game play mode!
notes.content:
[img]https://fbcdn-sphotos-f-a.akamaihd.net/hphotos-ak-xfp1/v/t1.0-9/12009566_875380365883294_4419898145641538106_n.jpg?oh=218c03f80096b27d64b48a748d96331f&oe=5665CD23&__gda__=1453535402_a3281cdc35c896bda12eafb778fd4228[/img]

We would like to switch the default game branch to the new "Abyss" game play mode before going to BIC festival so today is the day it happens!

[h1]The old version of the game can still be played by enrolling into beta -> oldversion[/h1]

For those of you who are new to the Abyss mode, here is summary of the new things in the game!

[h1] New world [/h1]

[img]https://fbcdn-sphotos-g-a.akamaihd.net/hphotos-ak-xfl1/v/t1.0-9/11999049_875376862550311_4154604629963487186_n.jpg?oh=e72123f42bf9fb524e3c3d6fd49d1ef5&oe=56696960&__gda__=1453490530_1ba86106ddb44eace50c8301c75ed787[/img]

[list]
[*]The world of Subterrain has gotten deeper instead of widely spread as before.
[*]New randomly generated maps for casino, hotel, square, plaza and districts. They can go as deep as 10 floors.
[*]All other previously incomplete levels are now in the game, including new Murray space center.
[*]Newly added Central control level
[/list]

[h1] New enemies [/h1]

[list]
[*]Added 2 new enemy types and more evolution levels for the existing mob types.
[*]New final form of evolution will be added shortly.
[/list]

[h1] New stories [/h1]
[list]
[*]The story and missions in the game has changed completely and there are many little stories and logs that gives you hints and reveals what happened in the colony.
[*]New escape plan
[*]There will be a new core story that relates to what happened to the colony and West's personal lines.
[/list]

[h1] New game play [/h1]

[img]https://scontent.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xpt1/v/t1.0-9/12003272_875376809216983_5665506061075542271_n.jpg?oh=b5061f836a561e1b6998519093b4137e&oe=567A5CAB[/img]

[list]
[*]New weapons.
[*]Mars colony facilities such as mine, biosphere, research and engineering are upgradable.
[*]New progression system for obtaining new items through research.
[*]Almost every research and production is now queued. Meaning, you can queue up some tasks and go out for a good hunting.
[*]Control the power supply of the colony. Reduce the spread of infection rise.
[*]Mutant invasion! Mobs will try to invade into the Central control. It is do or die situation if you are invaded!
[*]The world doesn't wait for Dr.West. The game is now running a simulation of infection rise as well as evolution level at the colony level instead of per unit as before.
[/list]

[h1] Localization [/h1]

[img]https://fbcdn-sphotos-h-a.akamaihd.net/hphotos-ak-xap1/v/t1.0-9/10421413_875379235883407_7209372661870522521_n.jpg?oh=7976e82b911e611740e9048ba0268a88&oe=5675DAEB&__gda__=1449718327_4145329bc36f110eec7757c5a2122ba3[/img]

The whole game is now localizable and we now officially supports Russian. Passionate community members are working on them so we will soon have support for : 
[h1]French , German , Chinese , Japanese with Russian officially supported. [/h1]
More languages are possible!

[h1] Leaderboards [/h1]

notes.title: Version 0.7.5.0 major public update
notes.content:
Version 0.7.5.0 major public update

Release Note : Version 0.7.5.0   01 June 2015

Major public update.

Survival 

[h1]- New : Sitting[/h1]
[img]http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_Sit.jpg[/img]
West can sit on the chair, sofa or bench. Stamina recovery rate is increased while sitting.

[h1]- New : Sleeping[/h1]
[img]http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_Sleep.jpg[/img]
West can sleep on the bed. Time will pass quicker and sleepiness condition will improve. Rest status which gives reduced stamina requirement condition will be invoked upon waking up.

[h1]- New : Drink from a tap[/h1]
[img]http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_Tap.jpg[/img]
West can drink from a tap at the risk of contamination. It has limited supply of water and it does not refill.


Combat

[h1]- New : Dodge move[/h1]
[img]http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_Dodge.jpg[/img]
West has new move to dodge or quick step away from danger by pressing space bar and the movement keys. Dodge move will drain his stamina.

[h1]- New : Shield[/h1]
[img]http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_Shield.jpg[/img]
West can block attacks by equipping power pack and hold click right mouse button. It can absorb up to 50% of incoming damage. Shield will drain energy from power pack when it is turned on and drains extra energy when it is hit. Damage absorption amount and their effects are very much in open for development. 

[h1]- New : Power melee attack[/h1]
[img]http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_PowerAttack.jpg[/img]
Melee attack move has changed from left mouse click to hold left mouse click and then release. Longer you hold the left mouse button more power West gathers before he releases to strike. You can gather the power up to 2 seconds which will result in 2x damage.


Graphics

[h1]- New : New style of fog.[/h1]
[img]http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_NewFog.jpg[/img]
Fog area that are not visible to West is now represented by gray of the game background. West still needs to explore the area with his vision plus some lights to be able to unveil the fog so any undiscovered area will still be represented by the darkness. This may reduce some immersion feelings but we think it improves the overall visuals quite a bit. We can also introduce the pure black fog as before through option or on the game difficulty selection.

[h1]- New : Cocoon update.[/h1]
[img]http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_Cocoon.jpg[/img]
Cocoons are updated with the new sprites. Their physics behavior have also changed. Now they will be anchored at the fixed point on the ground, and only their core will move about. This will make player less likely get stuck by the cocoons. Their death effect has been updated too. Future plan for the cocoon is that when they die, they can spawn some mutants and when you go near them they may occasionally attack you with some kind of tentacles.

[h1]- New : Decals.[/h1]
[img]http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_Decal.jpg[/img]
We have started placing much needed decals on the map. This is part of the ongoing environment improvements. Soon, we want to turn these maggots into some kind of bio traps and add other types of dangers to the environment.

[h1]- New : Lighting option[/h1]
[img]http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_LightOption.jpg[/img]
New graphics option - Lighting quality. (Low, Medium, High) This option can be used by a lower spec computer such as laptop with Intel HD 4000 graphics card to improve game performance. For a normal gaming pc, it shouldn’t have much effects at all and you can just set it to high. But with a low spec computer that has low GPU memory bandwidth, this option can improve game performance.
 
[h1]- New : Shop UI[/h1]
[img]http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_Shop.jpg[/img]
3D Printer shop UI has changed. Now, it accepts proper access cards as well as discount coupons. Access cards and coupons can be found throughout the game.

Other Notes :

- Changed : Max stamina is increased by 300%
- Melee attack kill can result in a better biomass drop yield.
- Added knock back force on melee attacks.
- Tutorial tips needs to be updated.
- Balancing needs to be tweaked as we have just introduced the new features.
- We have asked Valve for price adjustment approval. We have no idea when it will be approved.

notes.title: Version 0.7.3.7 released with new save options!
notes.content:
This release version has a new save options.

Ability to use these save options will be changed per difficulty options (which we are working on) but for now, we have unlocked for current mode.

Release Note : Version 0.7.3.7   12 May 2015

- Fixed : Scutum bug (can't enter rooms)

- Fixed : Pressing journal key (default j) opens journal when there was none.

- New : Save game in pause menu.

- New : Save points in the level to save the game.

[img]http://www.pixellore.com/Subterrain/Images/SavePoint.jpg[/img]

- New : Option to continue from last save game when you die without going back to main menu.

- New : Large power charger for terminal levels and new smaller ones at the hub levels. Max charge level for them are 1500 and 700 respectively. This should make energy requirement a bit easier.

- New : Keyboard remapping! This isn't fully GUI featured experience, but now you can remap the keyboard by changing settings.xml file (such as : C:\Users\saehoon\AppData\LocalLow\Pixellore\Subterrain\Settings\settings.xml ) If you break the setting by entering the same key or anything else, the game will overwrite the settings file with default one.

- Changed : medical item spawning chance at the medical bays.

On the next version, we will try to introduce first difficulty level selection and ability to skip tutorial levels.

Because of many core changes, your old save game may/may not work with this version. Thanks for your understanding.

Thanks everyone!

This isn't fully GUI featured experience, but now you can remap the keyboard by changing settings.xml file (such as : C:\Users\saehoon\AppData\LocalLow\Pixellore\Subterrain\Settings\settings.xml ) If you break the setting by entering the same key or anything else, the game will overwrite the settings file with default one.

- Changed : medical item spawning chance at the medical bays.

On the next version, we will try to introduce first difficulty level selection and ability to skip tutorial levels.

Because of many core changes, your old save game may/may not work with this version. Thanks for your understanding.

Thanks everyone!

notes.title: Subterrain version 0.7.3.2 with level map feature!
notes.content:
Version 0.7.3.2 has experimental level map feature!

Some of you asked for mini map, level map. And we listened. But features like this you will never know if it will help to make better game or not if you don't try it.

So we tried it. It is first version and still in experiment stage so there could be some bugs and it doesn't look very pretty.

[b]Press 'M' button to open map.[/b]

The map is based on current in game fog system. So the featured icons such as crafting 3d printer and research like won't show up if you have not discovered it yet.

We are thinking of maybe add some kind of feature where you can download the vague location of the locations for the cost of some of your resources. (Credits , whatever)

As always , feedback is welcome and please test them if you can.

Thanks.

notes.title: Subterrain retail key give away!
notes.content:
It's just one week before launch and we think it would be cool to do some sort of experiment give away event to really rally behind the game and spread the words!

So we are going to give away 10 Steam keys to applicants who is showing their interest with the game!

So apply here by replying the announcement and then show us your proof of enthusiasm. Example of such activity would be your posting on your Facebook, Steam groups, Twitter or just about anything!

[b]It would be good if you can actually post link to your activity if that is possible![/b]

If you can show us any proof that you have done something to spread the word, you are in for the draw!

The draw ends on 29th of April and the keys will be given on the 30th of April when the game launches. 

Top 3 applicants who has shown their most amount of activities (proofs) will each get two keys.

There will also be 4 lucky drawers, and they will receive one key each.

We don't know how this would work, but we will cross our fingers and trust gamers of Steam!
